item.title: Summary - Hurricane Simon (EP5/EP202026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...SIMON EXPECTED TO TURN TO THE NORTHWEST THIS EVENING... ...FLOODING RAINS TO CONTINUE ALONG THE COAST OF WEST-CENTRAL MEXICO... As of 5:00 PM MST Mon Oct 12 the center of Simon was located near 20.3, -106.9 with movement WNW at 3 mph. The minimum central pressure was 969 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 100 mph.
